summary: This Form 6-K filing by Addex Therapeutics Ltd on June 5, 2026, is a report of a foreign private issuer attaching a press release that convenes the company's 2026 Annual General Meeting. The filing does not disclose any special situation such as an acquisition, divestiture, activist campaign, strategic review, tender offer, going-private transaction, capital return, spin-off, rights offering, restructuring, liquidation, delisting, issuer tender, deal termination, SPAC activity, or management change. It is a routine corporate meeting notice. As a non-US filing on Form 6-K, it is equivalent to a standard current report announcing an annual shareholder meeting. No special situation event is present.
